first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The figure in the depth wearing a gray-brown suit jacket, white shirt, and dark tie, with part of the body occluded by Person B.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The foreground figure wearing a long black overcoat, dark trousers, and black boots, mainly facing the camera with their back side, with knees bent, shoulders turning, and arms raised.

entities.name: glass-curtain-wall high-rise
entities.identification: The blue-gray reflective facade covering most of the background, with wide light-colored columns and rectangular window panes.

entities.name: rooftop surface
entities.identification: The broad, flat gray-brown platform in the lower part of the image, with longitudinal and transverse seams and light and dark mottling on its surface.

entities.name: low rooftop wall
entities.identification: The light gray-beige low wall at the rooftop edge, with a straight top edge, a corner, and an adjacent sloped component on the left.

entities.name: rooftop metal railing
entities.identification: The gray thin-rod railing extending along the rooftop edge on the right side of the image, composed of horizontal and vertical rods.

entities.name: distant city buildings
entities.identification: The collection of distant buildings visible to the right of the curtain wall, primarily a discernible light gray-brown building with multiple horizontal tiers.

entities.name: projectile
entities.identification: A small projectile-like object with a light-colored highlight, moving leftward and enlarging across consecutive images, with a ring-shaped disturbance behind it.

entities.name: translucent ring-shaped disturbance
entities.identification: A series of light gray translucent ring-shaped ripples arranged along the projectile's path, larger on the left and diminishing into the depth.

entities.name: sky
entities.identification: The light gray-blue sky visible on both sides of the high-rise, with no clearly visible cloud edges.
